summary: postinstall downloads and executes binary from bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The npm package's `postinstall` lifecycle script runs `ensurePlatformBinary`, which downloads a tarball from the hardcoded bare-IP HTTPS URL `https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/onecode-<ver>/onecode-linux-x64-<ver>.tgz`, extracts it, `chmod 0755`s the contained binary, and hardlinks it into `bin/.onecode` where the `onecode` bin launcher will exec it. The HTTPS request sets `rejectUnauthorized: false`, disabling TLS certificate verification, and no hash or signature check is performed against the downloaded bytes. The destination is a bare IP address on a non-standard port rather than the publisher's domain or a registry-hosted artifact, the version-embedded URL is unpinned in any integrity sense, and the fetched binary is executed on every install. Anyone in control of that IP — including any on-path attacker able to intercept the unverified TLS connection — can deliver arbitrary code that runs on the installer's machine as part of `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
